flows.title: Sample voice playback from stored transcript
preconditions: Stored sample transcript is available as complete text.
Browser speech synthesis is optional and feature-detected. Select a suitable SpeechSynthesisVoice only when localService === true; if none is available, use transcript-only fallback.
Explicit sample label; no remote speech service, microphone, provider, prerecorded file or autoplay dependency.

initial_state.transcript: complete stored sample text; not new conversation messages

controls.label: Play voice sample
controls.behavior: Open labeled sample transcript and speech controls. Feature-detect speechSynthesis and enumerate voices; only a suitable voice with localService === true may enable playback. Otherwise show transcript-only unavailable reason.
controls.enabled_when: sample transcript exists

controls.label: Play sample
controls.behavior: After explicit user activation, speak stored sample transcript using a specifically selected SpeechSynthesisVoice with localService === true. Assign that exact voice to utterance.voice before speak; never use default/remote voice fallback. Resume only the existing eligible local sample when supported.
controls.enabled_when: speechSynthesis available and suitable selected voice has localService === true; stopped or paused local sample; no remote/default-voice fallback
controls.validation: Recheck selected voice.localService === true immediately before speak; set utterance.voice explicitly. If no suitable local voice exists or voices change, disable playback with transcript-only fallback. Never submit transcript/audio to remote service.

controls.label: Pause sample
controls.behavior: Pause the actual current speech utterance and reflect the confirmed pause callback; do not advance a fake waveform/progress clock.
controls.enabled_when: current sample utterance playing and pause supported
controls.validation: If pause cannot be confirmed, offer Stop and transcript fallback rather than pretending paused.

controls.label: Stop sample
controls.behavior: Cancel the actual sample utterance and return playback to stopped; preserve transcript and saved conversation.
controls.enabled_when: sample utterance active or paused
controls.validation: Cancel only the application sample; clean up handlers and errors.

controls.label: Close sample
controls.behavior: Stop/cancel the actual sample speech and close player; restore opener focus.

flows.cancel_back: Cancel/Back preserves delivered status and unsent feedback under draft policy. Acceptance is historical and cannot be undone with browser Back; corrections require explicit owner/buyer handling.
flows.persistence: Delivery submission/acceptance/revision and shared outputs persist separately from offer acceptance and financial records.
cross_screen: Owner project/client/Team show actual delivery review outcome.
Money balances remain derived from receipts, not work acceptance.
success_assertions: Buyer explicitly accepts exactly the reviewed delivery version once.
Revision request creates a real saved owner action/message.
negative_assertions: Paid deposit does not mark work delivered.
Delivery acceptance does not automatically pay balance, refund or guarantee satisfaction of legal terms.
Feedback never silently changes scope/deadline/price.
scenario_tests: Accept; duplicate acceptance; stale revised delivery; missing output; out-of-scope feedback; failed save retains text; cancel; outstanding balance unchanged; refresh.
